system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global coverage at 250m resolution, providing sand particle proportion (>0.05 mm) in fine earth fraction across all land areas.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Maintained reference dataset updated in 2020; represents current soil properties based on global soil sampling and modeling.
data_description.temporal_unit: Not a temporal series; static soil property reference

band_semantics.mean: Mean predicted proportion of sand particles (>0.05 mm) in the fine earth fraction at different soil depths (0-5cm, 5-15cm, 15-30cm, 30-60cm, 60-100cm, 100-200cm).

data_description.important_note: SoilGrids is a globally consistent, data-driven prediction system. For national/local analysis, compare with regional soil maps which may be more accurate. The 'mean' represents expected value and provides unbiased prediction.
analytical_capabilities: Coastal and inland sandy terrain characterization
Geological substrate influence on soil texture
Erosion and transport process pattern recognition

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Sand content in g/kg (grams per kilogram) or proportion in parts per thousand of fine earth fraction.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Values typically range from 0-900 g/kg; higher values indicate sandy soils often associated with recent sedimentary deposits, coastal areas, or specific parent materials.

data_description.data_source: International Soil Reference and Information Centre (ISRIC)
